data: Which line in Figure 4(a) represents the performance on high-frequency words?

The caption states that the figure shows RSIM scores, mapping performance (i.e., monolingual "BLI") on HFREQ and LFREQ EN words, and monolingual word similarity scores on SimVerb-3500. The lines in the graph represent these metrics. The legend indicates that the blue line corresponds to "Map: HFREQ," which stands for high-frequency words. Therefore, the blue line in Figure 4(a) represents the performance on high-frequency words.
